body:
Have you tried reproducing this with a resource you generate, rather than a resource that the editor also has references to?

It seems like the weak-ref may just still have the data because the editor is keeping a ref to it. It may also give more info to get the reference count (at various steps). I suspect that it's initially 1 when running the game, but higher when in the tool script.

Apologies for the wrong information, this doesn't appear to be a "true" regression after all. 
I was trying to summarly reproduce a section of my code (involving weakrefs in tool scripts) which had worked in 4.5.stable prior to upgrading to 4.6 and stopped working, but after testing in 4.5.stable (in the web editor) this example also reproduces the issue.

I'll have to figure out by what miracle did my code work previously

> Have you tried reproducing this with a resource you generate, rather than a resource that the editor also has references to?

I did, this indeed does not causes it to leak

I dug a bit deeper with printing reference count, and it seems the discrepancy in behavior comes actually from the history behaving differently between versions? The leak is most likely caused by the resource being referenced in the undo list when set from the inspector
In 4.5 (stable) setting from inspector repeatedly yields this
```
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 6
Set picture		(to null)
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 8
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 10
```
In 4.6 (stable) setting from inspector repeatedly yields instead
```
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 6
Set picture		(to null)
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 10
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 12
```
Somehow resetting to null also references the resource in this version

Working with weakrefs, I get this from 4.5 (here grabbing ref count from the weakref itself)
```
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 6
Set picture		(to null)
ref count 3
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 8
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 10
```
and 4.6
```
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 7
Set picture		(to null)
ref count 5
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 11
Set picture		(to GD icon)
ref count 13
```
I would guess the difference in behavior I observed came from me opening a scene with an already set resource and setting it to null, which in 4.5 wouldn't increment the ref count but in 4.6 would

Eh, it would be nice to bisect this to find what caused the difference, but I don't think it's really a bug. The editor may hold a reference to the resource for any reason and it gives no guarantees about it. You just hit a corner case where the undocumented behavior has changed. Why is this "leak" a problem? (which is not a leak, because the reference will be released when no longer need for whatever it is used)
